# Cobus van Vuuren

> Business Automation Assessments for South African professional services firms: accountants,
> attorneys, and financial advisors. Structured 90-minute intake, five-day turnaround,
> costed implementation plan. R50,000 minimum savings guaranteed or full refund.

## What Cobus does

Runs structured Business Automation Assessments for SA professional services firms.
Diagnostic-led, not tool-first. Finds where time is leaking, ranks opportunities by
impact-to-effort ratio, delivers a costed day-by-day implementation plan as a PDF.

## Services

- Business Automation Assessment: R5,497 (once-off)
- Implementation: R20,000 to R80,000 (separate engagement, post-assessment)

## Proof

- 7 years operating RhinoBerry digital marketing agency (South Africa)
- Guarantee: if the assessment doesn't find R50,000 in annual savings, full refund, no conditions

## ICP

Owner-operators of SA professional services firms: accountants (CA/SAICA), attorneys,
financial advisors (CFP/FAIS). 3 to 20 staff. R2m to R15m annual revenue. They bill by
the hour, so admin is direct revenue loss.

## What CVV is NOT

- Not an AI training course or workshop
- Not a technology vendor (no tools sold or resold)
- Not an open-ended retainer
- Not for marketing automation (that is RhinoBerry's lane)

## Built systems (case studies, not for sale)

Nine real systems, each documenting one automation built for a real business. Referenced
as proof-of-work, not offered as standalone products -- see /ai-automation/ for the full
index.

- Okapi -- file-based operating system: /ai-automation/okapi-ai-operating-system/
- Oxpecker -- review management: /ai-automation/oxpecker-review-management/
- The Office Automation Blueprint -- costed automation plan: /ai-automation/the-office-automation-blueprint/
- Nightjar -- call intelligence: /ai-automation/nightjar-call-intelligence/
- Growth Opportunity Scan -- channel-by-channel growth plan: /ai-automation/growth-opportunity-scan/
- Meerkat -- competitor watch: /ai-automation/meerkat-competitor-watch/
- SpoorSny -- marketing data connector: /ai-automation/spoorsny-marketing-data-connector/
- Social Media Studio -- editorial process for social posting: /ai-automation/social-media-studio/
- Echo Engine -- content repurposing: /ai-automation/echo-engine-content-repurposing/

## Background

Cobus van Vuuren founded RhinoBerry, a South African digital marketing agency, in 2019.
After automating RhinoBerry's own operations over three years, he launched CVV to offer
structured Business Automation Assessments to other professional services firms. The
methodology is the same diagnostic used on his own business first.
